v1.4.2 Update
🐛 Live Mode Chat Cards: Spell and item cards no longer appear as dialogue, including descriptions posted without a roll. Queued expressions wait for the next dialogue line.
🔎 Background Search: Search by location or variant name; matching groups open automatically.
🐛 Background Selection: Filtered results apply the correct background and preserve the Scene tab's scroll position.

announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.4.2
announcement.content:
Visual Novel Maker v1.4.2 fixes chat cards appearing as dialogue and improves background search.

  • Spell and item cards, including DnD5e and PF2e descriptions posted without a roll, stay out of the dialogue box and Dialogue Backlog. Queued expressions remain ready for the next dialogue line.
  • Live Director background search finds location and variant names. Matching groups open automatically, and a variant-name match shows only matching variants.
  • Filtered results now apply the correct background. Searching and toggling groups preserve the Scene tab's scroll position.
